description.en-US: The organization the file belongs to; null for a tenant-wide file. Not a foreign key: iam sorts after itstorage in the migration order, so the constraint would point upwards.
The file's display name, as uploaded. It never reaches the object key, which is built from the file id, so only path separators and control characters are refused.
The ISO media type the client declared. The upload checks it against the content's own signature, so a declared type of the wrong family is refused.
The immutable key of the stored object, {tenant_id|_}/{space_id}/{file_id}{ext}. Written by the upload only. A space rename never moves an object, which is why the key does not follow the space path.

pending until a record references the file, in_use while one does, and pending again once that record drops it. The stored object carries the same value in its itstorage-state tag, and a storage lifecycle rule expires objects tagged pending after 24 hours. Written by the storage port only.
When a record first referenced the file. A pending file with this set was released: it can no longer be referenced, because its object is already on its way to expiry.
The user who uploaded the file, whose storage consumption it counts towards. Null for a file a service or a seed stored. Not a foreign key: iam sorts after itstorage in the migration order.
